column3: When the conversation starts the player will ask MARCO if he has anything useful to say using one of the MARCO Greetings (recorded separately)

column4: A cloud weighs around a million tonnes

column3: (mildly surprised as you have been just told an interesting fact)

column4: This is because most scientists define wetness as a liquid’s ability to maintain contact with a solid surface, meaning that water itself is not wet, but can make other objects wet.
Good day. Apologies for the horse thing.
Good day. No, I should apologise. I should not have implied that you were the Prince of Darkness. The source of all evil. It was an overreaction to a lost apple.

This is me asking a question - what I am asking is quite different to what the player selected. This means we can have a list of questions like 'Ask the merchant about the shop', and when you select that option what Kim actually says is far more interestingly worded than that

column3: This is the first real interaction with MARCO
First time responding - Kim has called you Siri
column4: This is Marco, your personal assistant app!
It’s not really a case of ‘whatever’. I’m the most advanced AI that’s been devised. I don’t even rely on wifi, which is pretty useful given where you’ve found yourself.

I’m only bringing it up because – got to address it, elephant in the room – I did hear you say earlier that I was a, quote, ‘shitty version of Siri’. I realise this was ignorance rather than malice, but of course, it hurts. I’m many more times more powerful than Siri, Alex, any of these goons.
Fine. I didn’t mean to… like, I wouldn’t think it would be possible to hurt the feelings of a…

Of a machine. No. My super-intelligence is both blessing and curse. Anyway, what was it you wanted to ask? Another thing about my sophisticated human mimicry is that I quite often forget what the hell I’m meant to be doing.
I was asking you what date it is, what… what year it is.
